{{< include latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

An error-correcting code adds redundancy to a message
so that the receiver can recover it even after some symbols are changed.
This page covers the basic definitions,
the Hamming and Reed--Solomon codes,
and then how codes that can be decoded by reading only a few symbols
lead to central results of computational complexity.

## From codes to complexity {#sec-codes-to-complexity}

Complexity theory uses codes that can be decoded
by reading only a few symbols of the received word.
The [*Computational Complexity for Data Science*](https://morrison-lab.github.io/cds/)
library covers the complexity classes these results are about.
